zh.title: ScienceIDE · 科学集成开发平台：把真实科学代码变成可验证的科学环境
zh.summary: ScienceIDE 把真实科学代码、研究流程、任务目标和验证标准转化为可运行、可测量、可复现的科学环境。这些环境中已验证的交互轨迹用于训练 PhAI-IDE 系列模型，在留出的科学代码修复任务和若干通用基准上有提升。当前任务形态包括加速、发现、修复、复现和集成，并开放任务提案。
body: ScienceIDE 是一项面向真实科学代码库、研究任务和可验证科学经验的独立基础设施探索。
它把真实科学代码、研究流程、任务目标和验证标准转化为可运行、可测量、可复现的科学环境，让研究者能够在真实科学场景中开展 Agent 执行、模型训练和强化学习研究。
它的核心价值在于，把真实科学软件、领域判断、任务目标和可验证反馈组织到同一个可执行环境中，为科研 Agent、模型训练、强化学习和科学发现研究提供经验基础。ScienceIDE 不要求接入 ScienceBuddy 才能使用，也不依赖 JEPA-Anything 才能成立。
当前任务形态包括加速、发现、修复、复现和集成。ScienceIDE 可以独立服务于科学代码、科学任务、环境构建、任务验证和强化学习训练等场景。
这些环境中已验证的交互轨迹，用于训练 PhAI-IDE-72B、PhAI-IDE-9B 和 PhAI-IDE-4B。这一系列模型在训练中未见过（留出）的科学代码修复任务，以及在代码、推理、知识方向选取的若干通用基准上有提升，为科学经验向更广泛能力的正向迁移提供了证据。以上是在选定任务和基准上的观察，迁移能覆盖多大范围仍需更多评测。
项目主页、技术报告，以及 AItonomy Foundation 在 Hugging Face 上发布的三个模型权重，均已公开。技术报告收录了完整的设置与结果。ScienceIDE 持续开放任务提案。
zh.short: ScienceIDE 可验证的科学执行环境

en.title: ScienceIDE · science integrated development platform: turning real scientific code into verifiable environments
en.summary: ScienceIDE turns real scientific code, research procedures, task goals and verification criteria into scientific environments that run, measure and reproduce. The PhAI-IDE model family, trained on verified interaction trajectories from these environments, shows gains in held-out scientific-code repair and across selected general-purpose benchmarks. Current task forms are accelerate, discover, repair, reproduce and integrate, and task proposals are open.
body: ScienceIDE is an independent infrastructure exploration for real scientific codebases, research tasks and verifiable scientific experience.

It turns real scientific code, research procedures, task goals and verification criteria into scientific environments that run, measure and reproduce, so that researchers can do agent execution, model training and reinforcement-learning research in real scientific settings.

Its value is in organising real scientific software, domain judgement, task goals and verifiable feedback into one executable environment, an experiential base for research agents, model training, reinforcement learning and discovery research. ScienceIDE does not require ScienceBuddy to be used, and does not depend on JEPA-Anything to stand.

Current task forms are accelerate, discover, repair, reproduce and integrate. ScienceIDE serves scientific code, scientific tasks, environment building, task verification and reinforcement-learning training on its own.

PhAI-IDE-72B, PhAI-IDE-9B and PhAI-IDE-4B are trained on interaction trajectories verified in these environments. The model family shows gains in held-out scientific-code repair and across selected general-purpose benchmarks in code, reasoning and knowledge: evidence of positive transfer from scientific experience to broader capabilities. These are observations on selected tasks and benchmarks, and how far the transfer reaches needs further evaluation.

The project page, the technical report and the weights for the three models are public, released by AItonomy Foundation on Hugging Face. The technical report has the full setup and results. ScienceIDE stays open for task proposals.
